declaration.description: Golden Level 0 contract used by every CodeCraft business module.

delegates.CommandHandler: string CommandHandler(string cmd, int msgId, string[] args)
delegates.EventHandler: void EventHandler(string topic, int msgId, string filter, string[] args)

messaging.publish: public string[] Publish(string destination, string command, int msgId, params string[] args)
messaging.wildcard_destination: asynchronous, except SUBLIST which is synchronous FAN-IN
messaging.context: Legacy int msgId parameter carries a 32-bit context; logs render ctx=X8. Zero means unassigned/system activity.

publish_async.signature: public string[] PublishAsync(string destination, string command, int msgId, params string[] args)
publish_async.destination: One exact endpoint only, first match from receiver along ForwardTarget. Empty or wildcard destination returns EDEST; empty command EARGS; missing endpoint EUNKNOWN; not-started/stopped endpoint ENOTREADY.
publish_async.queue: Reuse existing RouteAsync/inbox/worker. Snapshot argument array. Immediate +OK:<ctx>,<endpoint>:CommandEnqueued acknowledges admission only, never handler success. No new queue implementation or Task/async-await dependency.
publish_async.context: Preserve nonzero msgId. Allocate once when zero; same ctx in admission, worker checkpoints and result/error.
publish_async.completion: Existing ExecuteAsync contract: /RESULT carries handler/fallback response, including an application +ERR response; /ERROR carries missing-handler/registered-handler exception. Callers subscribe before sending if they need completion; no automatic subscriptions/retry/pending registry. Existing fallback exception behavior is unchanged.
publish_async.ordering: Enqueue then worker execution; a fast completion event may be observed before the HTTP receipt. Same inbox ordering; no global cross-module ordering. Admission guard is not a concurrent Stop/drain guarantee.
publish_async.compatibility: Existing Publish behavior, public delegates and wildcard SUBLIST synchronous FAN-IN are unchanged.

handlers.registration: Derived RegisterHandlers calls RegisterHandler during Initialize; Start enables handlers.
handlers.default_command: protected virtual string DefaultAtCommandHandler(string command, int msgId, string[] args)
handlers.default_event: protected virtual void DefaultEventHandler(string topic, int msgId, string filter, string[] args)

subscriptions.identity: producer + consumer endpoint + topic pattern + delivery mode
subscriptions.filter_identity: FilterExpression is not part of identity; repeating SUB atomically updates only the filter.

filters.grammar: space=AND; unescaped |=OR; leading !=NOT; backslash escapes syntax
filters.aliases: $argN=pattern targets args[N]; unqualified terms target the final argument
filters.address_equality: $argN=@pattern strips leading @ for text/wildcard matching; NOT retains existing semantics; no numeric padding/normalization.
filters.address_comparison: Explicit @ operand parses both event value and comparison value as unsigned bare hexadecimal; valid 0..0x1FFFFFFFFFFFFF; no signs/0x/fractions/whitespace. Without @ retain double.TryParse. Standalone @scope:name remains reserved.

invariants: Keep ChainHead and ForwardTarget as the Level 0 routing topology.
Store cross subscriptions on the event producer.
Store no-filter internally as empty string and expose it as *.
Resolve interest before emit_event logging so uninterested events stay silent.
Preserve locks around mutable Hashtables and queues.
Do not change public delegate or Publish signatures.

Runtime.source_policy: The new target copies the explicitly supplied, hash-validated core candidate source byte-identically. Preserve original selected golden pair unchanged. Candidate remains UNVERIFIED until declared impact acceptance.
